entries.title: Ezekiel 11:1
segments: ¶Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the East Gate of the LORD'S house, which faces eastward; and there at the door of the gate were twenty-five men, among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:2
segments: And He said to me: "Son of man, these [are] the men who devise iniquity and give wicked counsel in this city,

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:3
segments: "who say, '[The time is] not near to build houses; this [city is] the caldron, and we [are] the meat.'

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:4
segments: "Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man!"

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:5
segments: Then the Spirit of the LORD fell upon me, and said to me, "Speak! 'Thus says the LORD: "Thus you have said, O house of Israel; for I know the things that come into your mind.

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:6
segments: "You have multiplied your slain in this city, and you have filled its streets with the slain."

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:7
segments: 'Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: "Your slain whom you have laid in its midst, they [are] the meat, and this [city is] the caldron; but I shall bring you out of the midst of it.

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:8
segments: "You have feared the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you," says the Lord GOD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:9
segments: "And I will bring you out of its midst, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and execute judgments on you.

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:10
segments: "You shall fall by the sword. I will judge you at the border of Israel. Then you shall know that I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:11
segments: "This [city] shall not be your caldron, nor shall you be the meat in its midst. I will judge you at the border of Israel.

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:12
segments: "And you shall know that I [am] the LORD; for you have not walked in My statutes nor executed My judgments, but have done according to the customs of the Gentiles which [are] all around you."'"

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:13
segments: Now it happened, while I was prophesying, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then I fell on my face and cried with a loud voice, and said, "Ah, Lord GOD! Will You make a complete end of the remnant of Israel?"

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:14
segments: ¶Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:15
segments: "Son of man, your brethren, your relatives, your countrymen, and all the house of Israel in its entirety, [are] those about whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, 'Get far away from the LORD; this land has been given to us as a possession.'

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:16
segments: "Therefore say, 'Thus says the Lord GOD: "Although I have cast them far off among the Gentiles, and although I have scattered them among the countries, yet I shall be a little sanctuary for them in the countries where they have gone."'

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:17
segments: "Therefore say, 'Thus says the Lord GOD: "I will gather you from the peoples, assemble you from the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel."'

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:18
segments: "And they will go there, and they will take away all its detestable things and all its abominations from there.

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:19
segments: "Then I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within them, and take the stony heart out of their flesh, and give them a heart of flesh,

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:20
segments: "that they may walk in My statutes and keep My judgments and do them; and they shall be My people, and I will be their God.

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:21
segments: "But [as for those] whose hearts follow the desire for their detestable things and their abominations, I will recompense their deeds on their own heads," says the Lord GOD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:22
segments: ¶So the cherubim lifted up their wings, with the wheels beside them, and the glory of the God of Israel [was] high above them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:23
segments: And the glory of the LORD went up from the midst of the city and stood on the mountain, which [is] on the east side of the city.

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:24
segments: Then the Spirit took me up and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to those in captivity. And the vision that I had seen went up from me.

entries.title: Ezekiel 11:25
segments: So I spoke to those in captivity of all the things the LORD had shown me.
